acts.name: Signal
acts.purpose: A dormant orb detects a distant impossible transmission.

acts.name: Awakening
acts.purpose: Ancient ruins answer and the orb awakens to agency.

acts.name: Departure
acts.purpose: The protagonist leaves safety and commits to the journey.

acts.name: Gates
acts.purpose: Successive thresholds test speed, scale, and resolve.

acts.name: Rupture
acts.purpose: The route breaks and the protagonist is visibly damaged.

acts.name: Transformation
acts.purpose: The broken orb is rebuilt into a new luminous form.

acts.name: Arrival
acts.purpose: The transformed protagonist reaches Andromeda and finds scale beyond itself.
